description: This file defines the AnnouncementForm class which extends AbstractFormProcessor. It manages the creation, validation, and persistence of an announcement form, including form fields for title, description, type, CTA URL/text, and active status. It interacts with the Announcement model and AnnouncementRepository to save data.

classes.name: AnnouncementForm
classes.description: Form processor class for creating, validating, and saving announcement forms.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Constructs the announcement form with fields for title, description, type, CTA URL and text, and active status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates form data and persists the announcement object to the database via AnnouncementRepository.

methods.name: getAnnouncementTypes
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of announcement types for the form's type choice field.
